artifacts.summary: Round-4 summary extended with dispatch 34: sub-phase 15.3 complete (the bridge, its Decidable payoff, and 15.3's gate), the resolution taken on the box-clause question, and three corrections to the plan.
Resume point: sub-phase 16.2's four pieces in dependency order with a recommended 16.2a/16.2b split, the L0 indexing mismatch to settle first, and 19 carried-forward environment hazards.

decisions_made: The box-clause gap is closed by resolution (a): Basic.lean gains BoxLabelFaithful (C3b) with boxLabelFaithful_iff_window, threaded as a hypothesis through the four soundness declarations that need it. Dispatch 33's non-blocking user_decision on this is closed, not carried forward, per the user-decision contract's rule that a fully reversible in-repository choice is recorded rather than re-asked; the reversal cost is stated in the handoff.

The bridge is stated at a window time rather than at a general time, because FoldF and FoldB are disjoint away from the diagonal, so no single window time carries both half-line readouts outside the window. exists_foldF / exists_foldB are therefore not consumed by the bridge, contrary to the plan's instruction.

No fwdLive_iff_mem_fwdLiveT is landed and none should be sought: it would be false, since FwdLive demands a bi-infinite run that the forward fixpoint alone cannot produce. The completeness direction does factor and both its halves are landed separately.

15.3's gate is discharged by proof rather than by evaluation; decide is infeasible because liveT is a greatest fixpoint iterated verts.card + 1 times whose every iteration runs an inner least fixpoint of the same height.
